description: Lignes du transport public SITAC is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agglomération de Chalons en Champagne. This dataset represents the public transport lines of Châlons-Agglo (SITAC), Community of Agglomeration of Châlons-en-Champagne. Coverage: Agglomération de Chalons en Champagne. The portal shows the English title as "SITAC public transport lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agglomération de Chalons en Champagne. Its keywords include chalons-en-champagne, bus, chalons, geospatial, sitac, culture-et-tourisme. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, GEOJSON, KML, WEB PAGE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
